references.title: DWDS: gerade
references.supports: No Wortzerlegung; the Adverb entry ('betont die Exaktheit einer Angabe: genau'), apart from the two Adjektiv entries

notes.rationale: gerade das, was die Männer einen 'Scharm' nennen, precisely that: DWDS's Adverb, so ADV (ADR 0054); geradezu's gold description 🎯 fits it too. DWDS gives no Wortzerlegung, so it is a bottom word, and indeclinable, so it has no Ending, not even ∅ (ADR 0051): the Root gerade alone.
